svg.aria-label: Bootstrap policy: the Placement selects the ManagedClusters sno and bm by their name label. The enforced policy gitops-bootstrap applies five templates in order: namespace, OperatorPolicy for OpenShift GitOps, ClusterRoleBinding, repository secret and root Application. The local Argo CD then syncs everything else from Git.
